description.value: Harrison Beach Hotel is a newly renovated boutique property managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, situated steps from Harrison Lake in scenic Harrison Hot Springs. The hotel offers lake-view and mountain-view suites with kitchenettes, an indoor pool, outdoor hot tub, and fitness room. Its central location—within walking distance of the beach, shops, and restaurants—makes it a practical base for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 160 Esplanade Avenue, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and active, confirming the hotel is open and operating under True Key Hotels & Resorts management. The OSM phone (+1-604-796-1111) differs from the website's consistently displayed toll-free number (+1 866 338 8111) across all pages, so I flag this and use the website value. The website mentions 'secure parking' but never references bike-specific storage; no cycling amenities (tools, pump, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, so these remain null.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM records +1-604-796-1111 but website consistently displays +1 866 338 8111 (toll-free) across all pages; OSM number may be outdated.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the hotel is physically located in Harrison Hot Springs, BC — a distinct municipality roughly 65 km from Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel in Harrison Hot Springs with a fully functional website and confirmed physical address.
